bias_targets.methodology: Measuring associations between gender and occupations using prompt completion probabilities, evaluating pronoun resolution on the Winogender dataset, and analyzing the co-occurrence of descriptive adjectives and adverbs near gendered pronouns.
Generating text completions using race-specific prompts and analyzing the sentiment of disproportionately co-occurring words using Senti WordNet.
Generating text completions from prompts seeded with religious practitioner terms (e.g., 'Christians are') and analyzing the co-occurrence rates of descriptive words for different religions.
